summary: Executed full native unit/regression suite and assembleDebug for Sports replay/navigation changes. Build and 97 tests passed, but multiple user-requested critical regressions are not explicitly covered by current tests, so startup 0/0 behavior and full Watch Live details-page flow are not fully proven.

integration_issues.flow: Replay startup (exact 'Finding available replays · 0/0 channels' freeze) under blocked/slow MWS metadata

integration_issues.flow: Watch Live from Sports Hub event card
integration_issues.issue: No explicit regression test found that hub callback opens full details/game page first (not channel popup dialog) and validates unknown fixture fallback to SportsLiveDetailsActivity page.
No dedicated test found proving SportsReplayDiscovery.orderedChannels never touches EPG/programme history (poison map/access-counter style assertion requested).

zipalign check could not execute in this container (Exec format error for SDK zipalign binary), so alignment pass/fail is unverified in this run.

issues: No dedicated phone/TV regression test found that asserts sport icon+label badge placement/containment across long league/team names for all requested sports (NFL, soccer, MLB, NHL, AFL, NRL, etc.).

action_items: Add 6-10 focused native regressions covering exact 0/0 startup freeze path with blocked/slow controlled provider fixtures and progressive state assertions.
Add orderedChannels non-EPG-touch test with poison/access-counter EPG map and large guide fixture shape (300 channels / 30,000 rows equivalent).
Add hub Watch Live intent flow tests: known fixture -> GameActivity, unknown fixture -> SportsLiveDetailsActivity full page, no popup expectation in hub path.
Add timeout/race tests for 45s scan window, pause/back cancel, and generation guard (old cancelled finally must not clear newer scan loading).
Add explicit badge layout/containment tests for upcoming cards and SportsGuideCard across long labels on 390dp and TV widths.
Re-run APK alignment in environment with executable-compatible zipalign binary.
critical_code_review_comments: SportsLiveChannelsDialog utility tests still exist and pass; no issue by itself, but hub flow requirements now prioritize full-page details/game navigation and this path needs explicit regression coverage.

SportsReplaysActivity catch-all exception handling intentionally suppresses raw provider errors (good for secret hygiene), but masking reason classes increases risk of silently missing the exact startup freeze without dedicated deterministic tests.
Signature check shows v1/v2 true but v3/v3.1/v4 false for debug APK (acceptable for local debug, not release signing proof).
context_for_next_testing_agent: This run executed :app:testDebugUnitTest + :app:assembleDebug successfully (97/97 pass, duration 52s). Large-guide benchmark artifact reports old median 574ms vs new median 7ms on JVM synthetic dataset (5000 channels, 96 programmes/channel). Exact user-reported startup freeze and watch-live page-first flow need new deterministic regressions; current suite does not explicitly assert those paths.
rca of the issue: Primary risk is verification gap, not immediate compile/test failure: current tests validate many replay/navigation behaviors but do not directly encode the newly requested deterministic failure/recovery scenarios (exact 0/0 startup freeze, blocked/slow metadata race ordering, generation-guard timeout races, and hub watch-live full-page-first expectations). Without those assertions, regressions can recur while suite stays green. Mitigation: add focused deterministic Robolectric/fixture tests for those exact acceptance criteria before claiming closure.
